title: Russian warship sinks in Benghazi after suspected Ukrainian drone attack
summary_full: No one has claimed responsibility for the strike on the vessel, which had docked on its way back to RussiaA Russian warship docked in the Libyan port city of Benghazi was struck in the early hours of Sunday in a suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack, causing a dramatic night-time explosion and the sinking of the vessel.The strike severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette that had stopped to refuel and take on supplies, according to Libyan officials from the country’s eastern government.
